143:     private fun processFiles(uris: List<Uri>) {
144:         tvStatus.text = "Processing ${uris.size} file(s)..."
145:         progressBar.visibility = View.VISIBLE
146: 
147:         Thread {
148:             val allText = StringBuilder()
149:             var processedCount = 0
150:             var errorCount = 0
151: 
152:             for (uri in uris) {
153:                 try {
154:                     val fileSize = getFileSize(uri)
155:                     if (fileSize > MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES) {
156:                         errorCount++
157:                         activity?.runOnUiThread {
158:                             Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "File too large (${fileSize / 1024 / 1024}MB). Max: ${MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB}MB", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
159:                         }
160:                         continue
161:                     }
162: 
163:                     val mimeType = requireContext().contentResolver.getType(uri) ?: ""
164: 
165:                     when {
166:                         mimeType.startsWith("image/") -> {
167:                             val text = processImageUri(uri)
168:                             if (text.isNotBlank()) {
169:                                 allText.appendLine(text)
170:                                 allText.appendLine()
171:                                 processedCount++
172:                             }
173:                         }
174:                         mimeType == "application/pdf" -> {
175:                             val text = processPdfUri(uri)
176:                             if (text.isNotBlank()) {
177:                                 allText.appendLine(text)
178:                                 allText.appendLine()
179:                                 processedCount++
180:                             }
181:                         }
182:                         mimeType.startsWith("text/") -> {
183:                             val text = processTextUri(uri)
184:                             if (text.isNotBlank()) {
185:                                 allText.appendLine(text)
186:                                 allText.appendLine()
187:                                 processedCount++
188:                             }
189:                         }
190:                         else -> errorCount++
191:                     }
192:                 } catch (e: Exception) {
193:                     errorCount++
194:                     activity?.runOnUiThread {
195:                         Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Error: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
196:                     }
197:                 }
198:             }
199: 
200:             activity?.runOnUiThread {
201:                 if (allText.isNotBlank()) {
202:                     editSourceText.append(allText.toString())
203:                     tvStatus.text = "Processed $processedCount file(s). Tap Generate."
204:                 } else {
205:                     tvStatus.text = "No text extracted from files."
206:                 }
207:                 progressBar.visibility = View.GONE
208:             }
209:         }.start()
210:     }
211: 
212:     private fun getFileSize(uri: Uri): Long {
213:         val cursor = requireContext().contentResolver.query(uri, null, null, null, null)
214:         cursor?.use {
215:             if (it.moveToFirst()) {
216:                 val sizeIndex = it.getColumnIndex(android.provider.OpenableColumns.SIZE)
217:                 if (sizeIndex >= 0) return it.getLong(sizeIndex)
218:             }
219:         }
220:         return 0L
221:     }
222: 
223:     private fun processImageUri(uri: Uri): String {
224:         val inputStream = requireContext().contentResolver.openInputStream(uri) ?: return ""
225:         val bytes = inputStream.readBytes()
226:         inputStream.close()
227:         if (bytes.isEmpty()) return ""
228: 
229:         var result = ""
230:         val latch = java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch(1)
231:         api.ocrImage(bytes) { ocrResult ->
232:             ocrResult.onSuccess { text -> result = text }
233:             latch.countDown()
234:         }
235:         latch.await(60, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.SECONDS)
236:         return result
237:     }
238: 
239:     private fun processPdfUri(uri: Uri): String {
240:         val inputStream = requireContext().contentResolver.openInputStream(uri) ?: return ""
241:         val document = PDDocument.load(inputStream)
242:         val text = PDFTextStripper().getText(document)
243:         document.close()
244:         inputStream.close()
245:         return text.trim()
246:     }
247: 
248:     private fun processTextUri(uri: Uri): String {
249:         val inputStream = requireContext().contentResolver.openInputStream(uri) ?: return ""
250:         val reader = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(inputStream))
251:         val text = reader.readText()
252:         reader.close()
253:         return text.trim()
254:     }
255: 
256:     private fun generate() {
257:         val deckName = editDeckName.text.toString().trim()
258:         val sourceText = editSourceText.text.toString().trim()
259:         val numCards = editNumCards.text.toString().toIntOrNull() ?: 5
260:         val numMcqs = editNumMcqs.text.toString().toIntOrNull() ?: 2
261:         val tags = editTags.text.toString().split(",").map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
262: 
263:         if (deckName.isEmpty()) { editDeckName.error = "Required"; return }
264:         if (sourceText.isEmpty()) { editSourceText.error = "Required"; return }
265: 
266:         btnGenerate.isEnabled = false
267:         progressBar.visibility = View.VISIBLE
268:         tvStatus.text = "Generating cards..."
269: 
270:         val deckId = DeckRepository(DatabaseHelper(requireContext())).create(deckName, tags)
271: 
272:         api.generateFlashcards(sourceText, numCards, tags) { result ->
273:             result.onSuccess { cards ->
274:                 flashcardRepo.add(deckId, cards)
275:                 activity?.runOnUiThread { tvStatus.text = "Cards done. Generating MCQs..." }
276: 
277:                 api.generateMCQs(sourceText, numMcqs, tags) { mcqResult ->
278:                     mcqResult.onSuccess { mcqs ->
279:                         mcqRepo.add(deckId, mcqs)
280:                         activity?.runOnUiThread {
281:                             tvStatus.text = "Done! ${cards.size} cards, ${mcqs.size} MCQs created."
282:                             progressBar.visibility = View.GONE
283:                             btnGenerate.isEnabled = true
284:                             editSourceText.text.clear()
285:                             editDeckName.text.clear()
286:                         }
287:                     }
288:                     mcqResult.onFailure { e ->
289:                         activity?.runOnUiThread {
290:                             tvStatus.text = "MCQs failed: ${cleanError(e.message)}. Cards saved."
291:                             progressBar.visibility = View.GONE
292:                             btnGenerate.isEnabled = true
293:                         }
294:                     }
295:                 }
296:             }
297:             result.onFailure { e ->
298:                 activity?.runOnUiThread {
299:                     tvStatus.text = "Error: ${cleanError(e.message)}"
300:                     progressBar.visibility = View.GONE
301:                     btnGenerate.isEnabled = true
302:                 }
303:             }
304:         }
305:     }
306: 
307:     private fun cleanError(msg: String?): String {
308:         if (msg == null) return "Unknown error"
309:         return when {
310:             msg.contains("429") || msg.contains("Queue full") -> "Server busy. Wait a few seconds and try again."
311:             msg.contains("Unterminated") || msg.contains("malformed") || msg.contains("parse") -> "AI response cut off. Try again."
312:             msg.contains("timeout") -> "Request timed out. Try shorter text."
313:             msg.contains("Could not find card data") -> "AI returned empty response. Try again."
314:             else -> msg.take(120)
315:         }
316:     }
317: }

package com.syedali.flashquiz.theme

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Color

data class AppTheme(
    val id: String,
    val name: String,
    val background: Int,
    val surface: Int,
    val surfaceVariant: Int,
    val accent: Int,
    val accentLight: Int,
    val textPrimary: Int,
    val textSecondary: Int,
    val textMuted: Int,
    val border: Int,
    val error: Int,
    val success: Int,
    val warning: Int
)

object ThemeManager {
    private const val PREFS_NAME = "theme_prefs"
    private const val KEY_THEME_ID = "current_theme_id"

    val themes = listOf(
        AppTheme(
            id = "dark",
            name = "Dark",
            background = Color.parseColor("#191B1D"),
            surface = Color.parseColor("#232527"),
            surfaceVariant = Color.parseColor("#393B3D"),
            accent = Color.parseColor("#00A2FF"),
            accentLight = Color.parseColor("#00A2FF"),
            textPrimary = Color.parseColor("#FFFFFF"),
            textSecondary = Color.parseColor("#A1A8AD"),
            textMuted = Color.parseColor("#656B70"),
            border = Color.parseColor("#393B3D"),
            error = Color.parseColor("#FF4444"),
            success = Color.parseColor("#00E054"),
            warning = Color.parseColor("#FFAA00")
        ),
        AppTheme(
            id = "light",
            name = "Light",
            background = Color.parseColor("#DEE1E3"),
            surface = Color.parseColor("#FFFFFF"),
            surfaceVariant = Color.parseColor("#F2F4F5"),
            accent = Color.parseColor("#00A2FF"),
            accentLight = Color.parseColor("#00A2FF"),
            textPrimary = Color.parseColor("#393B3D"),
            textSecondary = Color.parseColor("#656B70"),
            textMuted = Color.parseColor("#A1A8AD"),
            border = Color.parseColor("#BDC3C7"),
            error = Color.parseColor("#FF4444"),
            success = Color.parseColor("#00E054"),
            warning = Color.parseColor("#FFAA00")
        )
    )

    fun getCurrentTheme(context: Context): AppTheme {
        val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        val themeId = prefs.getString(KEY_THEME_ID, "dark") ?: "dark"
        return themes.find { it.id == themeId } ?: themes[0]
    }

    fun setTheme(context: Context, themeId: String) {
        val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        prefs.edit().putString(KEY_THEME_ID, themeId).apply()
    }
}

## 17. `ThemeHelper.kt`
```kotlin
package com.syedali.flashquiz.theme

import android.app.Activity
import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
import android.view.View
import android.widget.Button
import android.widget.EditText
import android.widget.ImageButton
import android.widget.ProgressBar
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.cardview.widget.CardView
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
import com.google.android.material.chip.Chip
import com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputLayout

object ThemeHelper {

    fun applyTheme(activity: Activity, theme: AppTheme) {
        activity.window.decorView.setBackgroundColor(theme.background)
        activity.window.statusBarColor = theme.background
        activity.window.navigationBarColor = theme.background
    }

    fun applyToView(view: View, theme: AppTheme) {
        when (view) {
            is CardView -> applyToCard(view, theme)
            is MaterialButton -> applyToMaterialButton(view, theme)
            is Button -> applyToButton(view, theme)
            is TextView -> applyToTextView(view, theme)
            is EditText -> applyToEditText(view, theme)
            is TextInputLayout -> applyToInputLayout(view, theme)
            is Chip -> applyToChip(view, theme)
            is ProgressBar -> applyToProgressBar(view, theme)
            is ImageButton -> applyToImageButton(view, theme)
        }
    }

    private fun applyToCard(card: CardView, theme: AppTheme) {
        card.setCardBackgroundColor(theme.surface)
    }

    private fun applyToMaterialButton(button: MaterialButton, theme: AppTheme) {
        val tag = button.tag?.toString()
        when (tag) {
            "accent" -> {
                button.setBackgroundColor(theme.accent)
                button.setTextColor(theme.textPrimary)
            }
            "surface" -> {
                button.setBackgroundColor(theme.surfaceVariant)
                button.setTextColor(theme.textPrimary)
            }
            else -> {
                button.setBackgroundColor(theme.surfaceVariant)
                button.setTextColor(theme.textPrimary)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun applyToButton(button: Button, theme: AppTheme) {
        button.setBackgroundColor(theme.surfaceVariant)
        button.setTextColor(theme.textPrimary)
    }

    private fun applyToTextView(textView: TextView, theme: AppTheme) {
        val tag = textView.tag?.toString()
        when (tag) {
            "primary" -> textView.setTextColor(theme.textPrimary)
            "secondary" -> textView.setTextColor(theme.textSecondary)
            "muted" -> textView.setTextColor(theme.textMuted)
            "accent" -> textView.setTextColor(theme.accent)
            "error" -> textView.setTextColor(theme.error)
            "success" -> textView.setTextColor(theme.success)
            else -> {
                // Keep default
            }
        }
    }

    private fun applyToEditText(editText: EditText, theme: AppTheme) {
        editText.setTextColor(theme.textPrimary)
        editText.setHintTextColor(theme.textMuted)
    }

    private fun applyToInputLayout(layout: TextInputLayout, theme: AppTheme) {
        val boxBg = GradientDrawable().apply {
            setColor(theme.surface)
            cornerRadius = 36f
            setStroke(2, theme.border)
        }
        layout.boxBackgroundMode = TextInputLayout.BOX_BACKGROUND_NONE
        layout.background = boxBg
        layout.hintTextColor = android.content.res.ColorStateList.valueOf(theme.accentLight)
    }

    private fun applyToChip(chip: Chip, theme: AppTheme) {
        val bg = GradientDrawable().apply {
            setColor(theme.surfaceVariant)
            cornerRadius = 48f
        }
        chip.background = bg
        chip.setTextColor(theme.accentLight)
    }

    private fun applyToProgressBar(progressBar: ProgressBar, theme: AppTheme) {
        progressBar.indeterminateTintList = android.content.res.ColorStateList.valueOf(theme.accent)
    }

    private fun applyToImageButton(button: ImageButton, theme: AppTheme) {
        button.setColorFilter(theme.textMuted)
    }

    fun getAccentColor(theme: AppTheme): Int = theme.accent
    fun getBackgroundColor(theme: AppTheme): Int = theme.background
    fun getSurfaceColor(theme: AppTheme): Int = theme.surface
    fun getErrorColor(theme: AppTheme): Int = theme.error
    fun getSuccessColor(theme: AppTheme): Int = theme.success
}

package com.syedali.flashquiz.theme

import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.fragment.app.DialogFragment
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.GridLayoutManager
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
import com.syedali.flashquiz.R

class ThemePickerDialogFragment : DialogFragment() {

    interface ThemeSelectionListener {
        fun onThemeSelected(theme: AppTheme)
    }

    private var listener: ThemeSelectionListener? = null
    private var currentThemeId: String = "dark"

    fun setListener(listener: ThemeSelectionListener) {
        this.listener = listener
    }

    fun setCurrentTheme(themeId: String) {
        this.currentThemeId = themeId
    }

    override fun onCreateView(inflater: LayoutInflater, container: ViewGroup?, savedInstanceState: Bundle?): View {
        return inflater.inflate(R.layout.dialog_theme_picker, container, false)
    }

    override fun onViewCreated(view: View, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState)

        val recycler = view.findViewById<RecyclerView>(R.id.recycler_themes)
        recycler.layoutManager = GridLayoutManager(requireContext(), 2)

        val adapter = ThemeAdapter(
            themes = ThemeManager.themes,
            currentThemeId = currentThemeId,
            onSelect = { theme ->
                listener?.onThemeSelected(theme)
                dismiss()
            }
        )
        recycler.adapter = adapter

        view.findViewById<MaterialButton>(R.id.btn_cancel).setOnClickListener {
            dismiss()
        }
    }

    override fun onStart() {
        super.onStart()
        dialog?.window?.setLayout(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)
        dialog?.window?.setBackgroundDrawableResource(android.R.color.transparent)
    }

    class ThemeAdapter(
        private val themes: List<AppTheme>,
        private val currentThemeId: String,
        private val onSelect: (AppTheme) -> Unit
    ) : RecyclerView.Adapter<ThemeAdapter.ThemeViewHolder>() {

        class ThemeViewHolder(view: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(view) {
            val viewPreview: View = view.findViewById(R.id.view_preview)
            val tvName: TextView = view.findViewById(R.id.tv_name)
            val tvCheck: TextView = view.findViewById(R.id.tv_check)
        }

        override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): ThemeViewHolder {
            val view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.context).inflate(R.layout.item_theme, parent, false)
            return ThemeViewHolder(view)
        }

        override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: ThemeViewHolder, position: Int) {
            val theme = themes[position]
            val isSelected = theme.id == currentThemeId

            val previewBg = android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable().apply {
                shape = android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable.RECTANGLE
                cornerRadius = 16f
                colors = intArrayOf(theme.background, theme.surface, theme.accent)
            }
            holder.viewPreview.background = previewBg

            val borderBg = android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable().apply {
                shape = android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable.RECTANGLE
                cornerRadius = 32f
                setColor(0x00000000)
                setStroke(3, if (isSelected) theme.accent else 0x33FFFFFF)
            }
            holder.viewPreview.parent?.let {
                (it as View).background = borderBg
            }

            holder.tvName.text = theme.name
            holder.tvName.setTextColor(theme.textPrimary)

            holder.tvCheck.visibility = if (isSelected) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
            holder.tvCheck.setTextColor(theme.accent)

            holder.itemView.setOnClickListener { onSelect(theme) }
        }

        override fun getItemCount() = themes.size
    }
}

package com.syedali.flashquiz.ui.home

import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.EditText
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import com.google.android.material.chip.Chip
import com.google.android.material.floatingactionbutton.ExtendedFloatingActionButton
import com.syedali.flashquiz.R

import com.syedali.flashquiz.data.DeckRepository
import com.syedali.flashquiz.theme.ThemeHelper
import com.syedali.flashquiz.theme.ThemeManager

class HomeFragment : Fragment() {
    private lateinit var deckRepo: DeckRepository
    private lateinit var adapter: DeckAdapter
    private lateinit var layoutEmpty: LinearLayout
    private lateinit var chipStats: Chip

    override fun onCreateView(inflater: LayoutInflater, container: ViewGroup?, savedInstanceState: Bundle?): View {
        return inflater.inflate(R.layout.fragment_home, container, false)
    }

    override fun onViewCreated(view: View, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState)
        val theme = ThemeManager.getCurrentTheme(requireContext())

        deckRepo = DeckRepository(DatabaseHelper(requireContext()))

        layoutEmpty = view.findViewById(R.id.layout_empty)
        chipStats = view.findViewById(R.id.chip_stats)

        applyTheme(view, theme)

        adapter = DeckAdapter(
            decks = deckRepo.getAll(),
            deckRepo = deckRepo,
            onDeckClick = { deck ->
                val fragment = com.syedali.flashquiz.ui.review.ReviewFragment.newInstance(deck.id, deck.name)
                parentFragmentManager.beginTransaction()
                    .replace(R.id.fragment_container, fragment)
                    .addToBackStack(null)
                    .commit()
            },
            onDeleteClick = { deck ->
                AlertDialog.Builder(requireContext())
                    .setTitle("Delete Deck")
                    .setMessage("Delete \"${deck.name}\" and all its cards?")
                    .setPositiveButton("Delete") { _, _ ->
                        deckRepo.delete(deck.id)
                        refreshDeckList()
                    }
                    .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
                    .show()
            }
        )

        val recycler = view.findViewById<RecyclerView>(R.id.recycler_decks)
        recycler.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(requireContext())
        recycler.adapter = adapter

        view.findViewById<ExtendedFloatingActionButton>(R.id.fab_add_deck).setOnClickListener {
            showAddDeckDialog()
        }

        refreshDeckList()
    }

    private fun applyTheme(view: View, theme: com.syedali.flashquiz.theme.AppTheme) {
        view.setBackgroundColor(theme.background)

        view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_welcome)?.setTextColor(theme.textPrimary)
        view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_subtitle)?.setTextColor(theme.textSecondary)

        val chipBg = GradientDrawable().apply {
            setColor(theme.surfaceVariant)
            cornerRadius = 48f
        }
        chipStats.background = chipBg
        chipStats.setTextColor(theme.accentLight)

        val emptyIcon = view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_empty_icon)
        emptyIcon?.setTextColor(theme.textMuted)

        val emptyTitle = view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_empty_title)
        emptyTitle?.setTextColor(theme.textPrimary)

        val emptySubtitle = view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_empty_subtitle)
        emptySubtitle?.setTextColor(theme.textMuted)

        val fab = view.findViewById<ExtendedFloatingActionButton>(R.id.fab_add_deck)
        fab.backgroundTintList = android.content.res.ColorStateList.valueOf(theme.accent)
        fab.setTextColor(theme.textPrimary)
    }

    private fun refreshDeckList() {
        val decks = deckRepo.getAll()
        adapter.updateDecks(decks)

        if (decks.isEmpty()) {
            layoutEmpty.visibility = View.VISIBLE
            view?.findViewById<RecyclerView>(R.id.recycler_decks)?.visibility = View.GONE
        } else {
            layoutEmpty.visibility = View.GONE
            view?.findViewById<RecyclerView>(R.id.recycler_decks)?.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        }

        var totalDue = 0
        for (deck in decks) {
            val stats = deckRepo.getStats(deck.id)
            totalDue += stats.dueCards + stats.dueMcqs
        }
        chipStats.text = "$totalDue due"
    }

    private fun showAddDeckDialog() {
        val theme = ThemeManager.getCurrentTheme(requireContext())
        val input = EditText(requireContext()).apply {
            hint = "Deck name"
            setPadding(48, 32, 48, 16)
            setTextColor(theme.textPrimary)
            setHintTextColor(theme.textMuted)
        }
        AlertDialog.Builder(requireContext())
            .setTitle("New Deck")
            .setView(input)
            .setPositiveButton("Create") { _, _ ->
                val name = input.text.toString().trim()
                if (name.isNotEmpty()) {
                    deckRepo.create(name)
                    refreshDeckList()
                }
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
            .show()
    }

    override fun onResume() {
        super.onResume()
        if (::adapter.isInitialized) {
            refreshDeckList()
        }
    }
}

package com.syedali.flashquiz.theme

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Color

data class AppTheme(
    val id: String,
    val name: String,
    val background: Int,
    val surface: Int,
    val surfaceHigh: Int,
    val accent: Int,
    val accentSoft: Int,
    val textPrimary: Int,
    val textSecondary: Int,
    val textMuted: Int,
    val border: Int,
    val error: Int,
    val success: Int,
    val warning: Int,
    val cardRadius: Float = 20f,
    val buttonRadius: Float = 16f,
    val inputRadius: Float = 14f
)

object ThemeManager {
    private const val PREFS_NAME = "theme_prefs"
    private const val KEY_THEME_ID = "current_theme_id"

    val themes = listOf(
        AppTheme(
            id = "dark",
            name = "Midnight",
            background = Color.parseColor("#0D1117"),
            surface = Color.parseColor("#161B22"),
            surfaceHigh = Color.parseColor("#21262D"),
            accent = Color.parseColor("#58A6FF"),
            accentSoft = Color.parseColor("#1F3A5F"),
            textPrimary = Color.parseColor("#F0F6FC"),
            textSecondary = Color.parseColor("#8B949E"),
            textMuted = Color.parseColor("#484F58"),
            border = Color.parseColor("#30363D"),
            error = Color.parseColor("#F85149"),
            success = Color.parseColor("#3FB950"),
            warning = Color.parseColor("#D29922")
        ),
        AppTheme(
            id = "light",
            name = "Paper",
            background = Color.parseColor("#F6F8FA"),
            surface = Color.parseColor("#FFFFFF"),
            surfaceHigh = Color.parseColor("#F0F2F5"),
            accent = Color.parseColor("#0969DA"),
            accentSoft = Color.parseColor("#DDF4FF"),
            textPrimary = Color.parseColor("#1F2328"),
            textSecondary = Color.parseColor("#656D76"),
            textMuted = Color.parseColor("#8C959F"),
            border = Color.parseColor("#D0D7DE"),
            error = Color.parseColor("#CF222E"),
            success = Color.parseColor("#1A7F37"),
            warning = Color.parseColor("#9A6700")
        )
    )

    fun getCurrentTheme(context: Context): AppTheme {
        val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        val themeId = prefs.getString(KEY_THEME_ID, "dark") ?: "dark"
        return themes.find { it.id == themeId } ?: themes[0]
    }

    fun setTheme(context: Context, themeId: String) {
        val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        prefs.edit().putString(KEY_THEME_ID, themeId).apply()
    }
}

parts.text: Now let me write all the fragment layouts.

input.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:orientation="vertical"
    android:background="#0D1117"
    android:paddingStart="@dimen/space_20"
    android:paddingEnd="@dimen/space_20"
    android:paddingTop="@dimen/space_24"
    android:paddingBottom="@dimen/space_8">

    <!-- Header -->
    <LinearLayout
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:orientation="horizontal"
        android:gravity="center_vertical"
        android:layout_marginBottom="@dimen/space_24">

        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_weight="1"
            android:orientation="vertical">

            <TextView
                android:id="@+id/tv_welcome"
                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:text="My Decks"
                android:textSize="@dimen/text_3xl"
                android:textStyle="bold"
                android:textColor="#F0F6FC"
                android:letterSpacing="-0.02" />

            <TextView
                android:id="@+id/tv_subtitle"
                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:text="Study materials at a glance"
                android:textSize="@dimen/text_sm"
                android:textColor="#8B949E"
                android:layout_marginTop="@dimen/space_2" />
        </LinearLayout>

        <com.google.android.material.chip.Chip
            android:id="@+id/chip_stats"
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="@dimen/button_height_sm"
            android:text="0 due"
            android:textSize="@dimen/text_sm"
            android:textColor="#58A6FF"
            android:clickable="false"
            app:chipBackgroundColor="#1F3A5F"
            app:chipCornerRadius="@dimen/radius_full"
            app:chipStrokeWidth="0dp"
            app:chipMinHeight="0dp"
            app:chipPaddingHorizontal="@dimen/space_12"
            xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto" />
    </LinearLayout>

    <!-- Deck list -->
    <androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
        android:id="@+id/recycler_decks"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="0dp"
        android:layout_weight="1"
        android:clipToPadding="false"
        android:paddingBottom="90dp"
        android:overScrollMode="never" />

    <!-- Empty state -->
    <LinearLayout
        android:id="@+id/layout_empty"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="0dp"
        android:layout_weight="1"
        android:orientation="vertical"
        android:gravity="center"
        android:visibility="gone">

        <TextView
            android:id="@+id/tv_empty_icon"
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:text="📚"
            android:textSize="56sp"
            android:layout_marginBottom="@dimen/space_20" />

        <TextView
            android:id="@+id/tv_empty_title"
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:text="@string/empty_no_decks"
            android:textSize="@dimen/text_xl"
            android:textStyle="bold"
            android:textColor="#F0F6FC"
            android:layout_marginBottom="@dimen/space_8" />

        <TextView
            android:id="@+id/tv_empty_subtitle"
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:text="@string/empty_no_decks_sub"
            android:textColor="#8B949E"
            android:textSize="@dimen/text_md"
            android:gravity="center" />
    </LinearLayout>

    <!-- FAB -->
    <com.google.android.material.floatingactionbutton.ExtendedFloatingActionButton
        android:id="@+id/fab_add_deck"
        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_gravity="bottom|end"
        android:text="@string/btn_create"
        android:textColor="#FFFFFF"
        android:textSize="@dimen/text_md"
        android:textStyle="bold"
        android:backgroundTint="#58A6FF"
        app:icon="@drawable/ic_nav_create"
        app:iconTint="#FFFFFF"
        app:fabSize="normal"
        app:elevation="6dp"
        android:layout_marginBottom="@dimen/space_16"
        xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto" />

</LinearLayout>

parts.text: Now let me write the generate fragment layout with a step-by-step flow.

input.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<ScrollView xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:background="#0D1117"
    android:fillViewport="true"
    android:overScrollMode="never">

    <LinearLayout
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:orientation="vertical"
        android:paddingStart="@dimen/space_20"
        android:paddingEnd="@dimen/space_20"
        android:paddingTop="@dimen/space_24"
        android:paddingBottom="@dimen/space_32">

        <!-- Header -->
        <TextView
            android:id="@+id/tv_title"
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:text="Create Deck"
            android:textSize="@dimen/text_3xl"
            android:textStyle="bold"
            android:textColor="#F0F6FC"
            android:letterSpacing="-0.02"
            android:layout_marginBottom="@dimen/space_4" />

        <TextView
            android:id="@+id/tv_subtitle"
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:text="Add content and AI will generate study cards"
            android:textColor="#8B949E"
            android:textSize="@dimen/text_md"
            android:layout_marginBottom="@dimen/space_28" />

        <!-- Step 1: Deck Name -->
        <TextView
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:text="1. Name your deck"
            android:textSize="@dimen/text_sm"
            android:textStyle="bold"
            android:textColor="#8B949E"
            android:letterSpacing="0.05"
            android:layout_marginBottom="@dimen/space_12" />

        <EditText
            android:id="@+id/edit_deck_name"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="@dimen/input_height"
            android:hint="e.g. Biology Chapter 5"
            android:inputType="textCapWords"
            android:textSize="@dimen/text_md"
            android:textColor="#F0F6FC"
            android:textColorHint="#484F58"
            android:paddingStart="@dimen/space_16"
            android:paddingEnd="@dimen/space_16"
            android:background="@drawable/bg_input_dark"
            android:layout_marginBottom="@dimen/space_24" />

        <!-- Step 2: Add Content -->
        <TextView
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:text="2. Add your content"
            android:textSize="@dimen/text_sm"
            android:textStyle="bold"
            android:textColor="#8B949E"
            android:letterSpacing="0.05"
            android:layout_marginBottom="@dimen/space_12" />

        <EditText
            android:id="@+id/edit_source_text"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="150dp"
            android:hint="Paste notes, textbook content, or lecture material here..."
            android:gravity="top|start"
            android:textSize="@dimen/text_md"
            android:textColor="#F0F6FC"
            android:textColorHint="#484F58"
            android:lineSpacingExtra="4dp"
            android:padding="@dimen/space_16"
            android:inputType="textMultiLine"
            android:background="@drawable/bg_input_dark"
            android:layout_marginBottom="@dimen/space_12" />

        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:orientation="horizontal"
            android:layout_marginBottom="@dimen/space_4">

            <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
                android:id="@+id/btn_ocr"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="@dimen/button_height_sm"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:text="📷  Scan"
                android:textAllCaps="false"
                android:textSize="@dimen/text_sm"
                android:textColor="#F0F6FC"
                android:layout_marginEnd="@dimen/space_8"
                android:backgroundTint="#21262D" />

            <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
                android:id="@+id/btn_import_pdf"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="@dimen/button_height_sm"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:text="📄  Import"
                android:textAllCaps="false"
                android:textSize="@dimen/text_sm"
                android:textColor="#F0F6FC"
                android:backgroundTint="#21262D" />
        </LinearLayout>

        <TextView
            android:id="@+id/tv_file_hint"
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:text="Images, PDFs, text files up to 50MB"
            android:textColor="#484F58"
            android:textSize="@dimen/text_xs"
            android:layout_marginBottom="@dimen/space_24" />

        <!-- Step 3: Configure -->
        <TextView
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:text="3. How many to generate"
            android:textSize="@dimen/text_sm"
            android:textStyle="bold"
            android:textColor="#8B949E"
            android:letterSpacing="0.05"
            android:layout_marginBottom="@dimen/space_12" />

        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:orientation="horizontal"
            android:layout_marginBottom="@dimen/space_12">

            <EditText
                android:id="@+id/edit_num_cards"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="@dimen/input_height"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:hint="Flashcards"
                android:inputType="number"
                android:text="5"
                android:textSize="@dimen/text_md"
                android:textColor="#F0F6FC"
                android:textColorHint="#484F58"
                android:paddingStart="@dimen/space_16"
                android:paddingEnd="@dimen/space_16"
                android:background="@drawable/bg_input_dark"
                android:layout_marginEnd="@dimen/space_12" />

            <EditText
                android:id="@+id/edit_num_mcqs"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="@dimen/input_height"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:hint="MCQs"
                android:inputType="number"
                android:text="3"
                android:textSize="@dimen/text_md"
                android:textColor="#F0F6FC"
                android:textColorHint="#484F58"
                android:paddingStart="@dimen/space_16"
                android:paddingEnd="@dimen/space_16"
                android:background="@drawable/bg_input_dark" />
        </LinearLayout>

        <EditText
            android:id="@+id/edit_tags"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="@dimen/input_height"
            android:hint="Tags (optional)"
            android:inputType="text"
            android:textSize="@dimen/text_md"
            android:textColor="#F0F6FC"
            android:textColorHint="#484F58"
            android:paddingStart="@dimen/space_16"
            android:paddingEnd="@dimen/space_16"
            android:background="@drawable/bg_input_dark"
            android:layout_marginBottom="@dimen/space_28" />

        <!-- Status -->
        <com.google.android.material.progressindicator.LinearProgressIndicator
            android:id="@+id/progress_bar"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:visibility="gone"
            android:indeterminate="true"
            android:indeterminateTint="#58A6FF"
            android:layout_marginBottom="@dimen/space_12" />

        <TextView
            android:id="@+id/tv_status"

package com.syedali.flashquiz

import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.core.view.WindowCompat
import androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsControllerCompat
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
import com.google.android.material.bottomnavigation.BottomNavigationView
import com.syedali.flashquiz.theme.ThemeHelper
import com.syedali.flashquiz.theme.ThemeManager
import com.syedali.flashquiz.ui.generate.GenerateFragment
import com.syedali.flashquiz.ui.home.HomeFragment
import com.syedali.flashquiz.ui.mcq.MCQReviewFragment
import com.syedali.flashquiz.ui.review.ReviewFragment

class MainActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    private lateinit var currentTheme: com.syedali.flashquiz.theme.AppTheme
    private lateinit var bottomNav: BottomNavigationView

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_main)

        WindowCompat.setDecorFitsSystemWindows(window, false)
        val controller = WindowInsetsControllerCompat(window, window.decorView)
        currentTheme = ThemeManager.getCurrentTheme(this)
        controller.isAppearanceLightStatusBars = currentTheme.id == "light"
        controller.isAppearanceLightNavigationBars = currentTheme.id == "light"

        applyTheme()

        bottomNav = findViewById(R.id.bottom_nav)
        bottomNav.setOnItemSelectedListener { item ->
            val fragment: Fragment = when (item.itemId) {
                R.id.nav_home -> HomeFragment()
                R.id.nav_generate -> GenerateFragment()
                R.id.nav_review -> ReviewFragment()
                R.id.nav_mcq -> MCQReviewFragment()
                else -> HomeFragment()
            }
            supportFragmentManager.beginTransaction()
                .setCustomAnimations(android.R.anim.fade_in, android.R.anim.fade_out)
                .replace(R.id.fragment_container, fragment)
                .commit()
            true
        }

        if (savedInstanceState == null) {
            supportFragmentManager.beginTransaction()
                .replace(R.id.fragment_container, HomeFragment())
                .commit()
        }
    }

    private fun applyTheme() {
        ThemeHelper.applyTheme(this, currentTheme)
        if (::bottomNav.isInitialized) {
            bottomNav.setBackgroundColor(currentTheme.background)
            bottomNav.itemIconTintList = android.content.res.ColorStateList.valueOf(currentTheme.textMuted)
            bottomNav.itemTextColor = android.content.res.ColorStateList.valueOf(currentTheme.textMuted)
        }
    }

    override fun onResume() {
        super.onResume()
        val newTheme = ThemeManager.getCurrentTheme(this)
        if (newTheme.id != currentTheme.id) {
            currentTheme = newTheme
            applyTheme()
            recreate()
        }
    }
}

package com.syedali.flashquiz.ui.home

import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.view.animation.DecelerateInterpolator
import android.widget.EditText
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import com.google.android.material.chip.Chip
import com.google.android.material.floatingactionbutton.ExtendedFloatingActionButton
import com.syedali.flashquiz.R
import com.syedali.flashquiz.data.DatabaseHelper
import com.syedali.flashquiz.data.DeckRepository
import com.syedali.flashquiz.theme.ThemeManager

class HomeFragment : Fragment() {
    private lateinit var deckRepo: DeckRepository
    private lateinit var adapter: DeckAdapter
    private lateinit var layoutEmpty: LinearLayout
    private lateinit var chipStats: Chip

    override fun onCreateView(inflater: LayoutInflater, container: ViewGroup?, savedInstanceState: Bundle?): View {
        return inflater.inflate(R.layout.fragment_home, container, false)
    }

    override fun onViewCreated(view: View, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState)
        val theme = ThemeManager.getCurrentTheme(requireContext())
        deckRepo = DeckRepository(DatabaseHelper(requireContext()))

        layoutEmpty = view.findViewById(R.id.layout_empty)
        chipStats = view.findViewById(R.id.chip_stats)

        applyTheme(view, theme)

        adapter = DeckAdapter(
            decks = deckRepo.getAll(),
            deckRepo = deckRepo,
            onDeckClick = { deck ->
                val fragment = com.syedali.flashquiz.ui.review.ReviewFragment.newInstance(deck.id, deck.name)
                parentFragmentManager.beginTransaction()
                    .setCustomAnimations(android.R.anim.fade_in, android.R.anim.fade_out)
                    .replace(R.id.fragment_container, fragment)
                    .addToBackStack(null)
                    .commit()
            },
            onDeleteClick = { deck ->
                AlertDialog.Builder(requireContext())
                    .setTitle("Delete Deck")
                    .setMessage("Delete \"${deck.name}\" and all its cards? This cannot be undone.")
                    .setPositiveButton("Delete") { _, _ ->
                        deckRepo.delete(deck.id)
                        refreshDeckList()
                    }
                    .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
                    .show()
            }
        )

        val recycler = view.findViewById<RecyclerView>(R.id.recycler_decks)
        recycler.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(requireContext())
        recycler.adapter = adapter

        view.findViewById<ExtendedFloatingActionButton>(R.id.fab_add_deck).setOnClickListener {
            showAddDeckDialog()
        }

        refreshDeckList()

        // Animate in
        view.alpha = 0f
        view.translationY = 20f
        view.animate()
            .alpha(1f)
            .translationY(0f)
            .setDuration(350)
            .setInterpolator(DecelerateInterpolator(1.5f))
            .start()
    }

    private fun applyTheme(view: View, theme: com.syedali.flashquiz.theme.AppTheme) {
        view.setBackgroundColor(theme.background)

        view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_welcome)?.setTextColor(theme.textPrimary)
        view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_subtitle)?.setTextColor(theme.textSecondary)

        val chipBg = GradientDrawable().apply {
            setColor(theme.accentSoft)
            cornerRadius = 48f
        }
        chipStats.background = chipBg
        chipStats.setTextColor(theme.accent)

        val emptyIcon = view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_empty_icon)
        emptyIcon?.setTextColor(theme.textMuted)
        val emptyTitle = view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_empty_title)
        emptyTitle?.setTextColor(theme.textPrimary)
        val emptySubtitle = view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_empty_subtitle)
        emptySubtitle?.setTextColor(theme.textSecondary)

        val fab = view.findViewById<ExtendedFloatingActionButton>(R.id.fab_add_deck)
        fab.backgroundTintList = android.content.res.ColorStateList.valueOf(theme.accent)
        fab.setTextColor(-1)
    }

    private fun refreshDeckList() {
        val decks = deckRepo.getAll()
        adapter.updateDecks(decks)

        if (decks.isEmpty()) {
            layoutEmpty.visibility = View.VISIBLE
            view?.findViewById<RecyclerView>(R.id.recycler_decks)?.visibility = View.GONE
        } else {
            layoutEmpty.visibility = View.GONE
            view?.findViewById<RecyclerView>(R.id.recycler_decks)?.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        }

        var totalDue = 0
        for (deck in decks) {
            val stats = deckRepo.getStats(deck.id)
            totalDue += stats.dueCards + stats.dueMcqs
        }
        chipStats.text = if (totalDue > 0) "$totalDue due" else "All caught up"
    }

    private fun showAddDeckDialog() {
        val theme = ThemeManager.getCurrentTheme(requireContext())
        val input = EditText(requireContext()).apply {
            hint = "Deck name"
            setPadding(48, 32, 48, 16)
            setTextColor(theme.textPrimary)
            setHintTextColor(theme.textMuted)
        }
        AlertDialog.Builder(requireContext())
            .setTitle("New Deck")
            .setView(input)
            .setPositiveButton("Create") { _, _ ->
                val name = input.text.toString().trim()
                if (name.isNotEmpty()) {
                    deckRepo.create(name)
                    refreshDeckList()
                }
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
            .show()
    }

    override fun onResume() {
        super.onResume()
        if (::adapter.isInitialized) {
            refreshDeckList()
        }
    }
}

package com.syedali.flashquiz.ui.mcq

import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.view.animation.DecelerateInterpolator
import android.view.animation.OvershootInterpolator
import android.widget.AdapterView
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.Spinner
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
import com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
import com.syedali.flashquiz.R
import com.syedali.flashquiz.data.DatabaseHelper
import com.syedali.flashquiz.data.DeckRepository
import com.syedali.flashquiz.data.MCQRepository
import com.syedali.flashquiz.model.Deck
import com.syedali.flashquiz.model.MCQ
import com.syedali.flashquiz.theme.ThemeManager

class MCQReviewFragment : Fragment() {
    private lateinit var deckRepo: DeckRepository
    private lateinit var mcqRepo: MCQRepository
    private var decks = listOf<Deck>()
    private var currentMCQs = mutableListOf<MCQ>()
    private var currentIndex = 0
    private var deckId: Long = -1
    private var selectedAnswer = -1
    private var isAnswered = false
    private var correctCount = 0
    private var wrongCount = 0

    private lateinit var tvTitle: TextView
    private lateinit var tvDeckName: TextView
    private lateinit var tvProgress: TextView
    private lateinit var spinnerDeck: Spinner
    private lateinit var tvQuestionNumber: TextView
    private lateinit var tvQuestion: TextView
    private lateinit var layoutOptions: LinearLayout
    private lateinit var layoutExplanation: LinearLayout
    private lateinit var tvExplanation: TextView
    private lateinit var btnNext: MaterialButton
    private lateinit var layoutEmpty: LinearLayout
    private lateinit var layoutScoreBar: LinearLayout
    private lateinit var tvScoreCorrect: TextView
    private lateinit var tvScoreWrong: TextView

    companion object {
        fun newInstance(deckId: Long, deckName: String): MCQReviewFragment {
            return MCQReviewFragment().apply {
                arguments = Bundle().apply {
                    putLong("deck_id", deckId)
                    putString("deck_name", deckName)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onCreateView(inflater: LayoutInflater, container: ViewGroup?, savedInstanceState: Bundle?): View {
        return inflater.inflate(R.layout.fragment_mcq_review, container, false)
    }

    override fun onViewCreated(view: View, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState)
        val dbHelper = DatabaseHelper(requireContext())
        deckRepo = DeckRepository(dbHelper)
        mcqRepo = MCQRepository(dbHelper)

        tvTitle = view.findViewById(R.id.tv_title)
        tvDeckName = view.findViewById(R.id.tv_deck_name)
        tvProgress = view.findViewById(R.id.tv_progress)
        spinnerDeck = view.findViewById(R.id.spinner_deck)
        tvQuestionNumber = view.findViewById(R.id.tv_question_number)
        tvQuestion = view.findViewById(R.id.tv_question)
        layoutOptions = view.findViewById(R.id.layout_options)
        layoutExplanation = view.findViewById(R.id.layout_explanation)
        tvExplanation = view.findViewById(R.id.tv_explanation)
        btnNext = view.findViewById(R.id.btn_next)
        layoutEmpty = view.findViewById(R.id.layout_empty)
        layoutScoreBar = view.findViewById(R.id.layout_score_bar)
        tvScoreCorrect = view.findViewById(R.id.tv_score_correct)
        tvScoreWrong = view.findViewById(R.id.tv_score_wrong)

        applyTheme(view)

        deckId = arguments?.getLong("deck_id", -1) ?: -1
        val deckName = arguments?.getString("deck_name", "")

        if (deckId != -1L) {
            tvDeckName.text = deckName
            spinnerDeck.visibility = View.GONE
            loadDueMCQs(deckId)
        } else {
            setupDeckSpinner()
        }

        btnNext.setOnClickListener {
            if (isAnswered) {
                currentIndex++
                selectedAnswer = -1
                isAnswered = false
                showMCQ()
            }
        }

        // Animate in
        view.alpha = 0f
        view.translationY = 20f
        view.animate()
            .alpha(1f)
            .translationY(0f)
            .setDuration(350)
            .setInterpolator(DecelerateInterpolator(1.5f))
            .start()
    }

    private fun applyTheme(view: View) {
        val theme = ThemeManager.getCurrentTheme(requireContext())
        view.setBackgroundColor(theme.background)
        tvTitle.setTextColor(theme.textPrimary)
        tvDeckName.setTextColor(theme.textSecondary)
        tvProgress.setTextColor(theme.accent)
        tvQuestionNumber.setTextColor(theme.accent)
        tvQuestion.setTextColor(theme.textPrimary)
        tvExplanation.setTextColor(theme.textSecondary)

        val nextBg = GradientDrawable().apply {
            shape = GradientDrawable.RECTANGLE
            cornerRadius = 16f
            setColor(theme.accent)
        }
        btnNext.background = nextBg
        btnNext.setTextColor(-1)

        val scoreBg = GradientDrawable().apply {
            shape = GradientDrawable.RECTANGLE
            cornerRadius = 48f
            setColor(theme.accentSoft)
        }
        layoutScoreBar.background = scoreBg

        tvScoreCorrect.setTextColor(theme.success)
        tvScoreWrong.setTextColor(theme.error)

        layoutExplanation.setBackgroundColor(theme.surface)

        val emptyIcon = view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_empty_icon)
        emptyIcon?.setTextColor(theme.textMuted)
        val emptyTitle = view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_empty_title)
        emptyTitle?.setTextColor(theme.textPrimary)
        val emptySubtitle = view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_empty_subtitle)
        emptySubtitle?.setTextColor(theme.textSecondary)
    }

    private fun setupDeckSpinner() {
        decks = deckRepo.getAll()
        if (decks.isEmpty()) {
            tvDeckName.text = "No decks"
            layoutEmpty.visibility = View.VISIBLE
            tvQuestion.visibility = View.GONE
            tvQuestionNumber.visibility = View.GONE
            layoutOptions.visibility = View.GONE
            layoutExplanation.visibility = View.GONE
            btnNext.visibility = View.GONE
            layoutScoreBar.visibility = View.GONE
            return
        }

        val names = decks.map { it.name }
        val adapter = ArrayAdapter(requireContext(), android.R.layout.simple_spinner_dropdown_item, names)
        spinnerDeck.adapter = adapter
        spinnerDeck.visibility = View.VISIBLE

        spinnerDeck.onItemSelectedListener = object : AdapterView.OnItemSelectedListener {
            override fun onItemSelected(parent: AdapterView<*>?, view: View?, position: Int, id: Long) {
                deckId = decks[position].id
                tvDeckName.text = decks[position].name
                loadDueMCQs(deckId)
            }
            override fun onNothingSelected(parent: AdapterView<*>?) {}
        }
    }

    private fun loadDueMCQs(deckId: Long) {
        currentMCQs = mcqRepo.getDue(deckId).toMutableList()
        currentIndex = 0
        selectedAnswer = -1
        isAnswered = false
        correctCount = 0
        wrongCount = 0

        if (currentMCQs.isEmpty()) {
            tvQuestion.visibility = View.GONE
            tvQuestionNumber.visibility = View.GONE
            layoutOptions.visibility = View.GONE
            layoutExplanation.visibility = View.GONE
            btnNext.visibility = View.GONE
            layoutScoreBar.visibility = View.GONE
            layoutEmpty.visibility = View.VISIBLE
            tvProgress.text = "0/0"
        } else {
            tvQuestion.visibility = View.VISIBLE
            tvQuestionNumber.visibility = View.VISIBLE
            layoutOptions.visibility = View.VISIBLE
            layoutEmpty.visibility = View.GONE
            layoutScoreBar.visibility = View.VISIBLE
            tvProgress.text = "${currentIndex + 1}/${currentMCQs.size}"
            updateScoreDisplay()
            showMCQ()
        }
    }

    private fun updateScoreDisplay() {
        tvScoreCorrect.text = "✓ $correctCount"
        tvScoreWrong.text = "✗ $wrongCount"
    }

    private fun showMCQ() {
        if (currentIndex >= currentMCQs.size) {
            tvQuestion.visibility = View.GONE
            tvQuestionNumber.visibility = View.GONE
            layoutOptions.visibility = View.GONE
            layoutExplanation.visibility = View.GONE
            btnNext.visibility = View.GONE
            layoutEmpty.visibility = View.VISIBLE
            tvProgress.text = "${currentMCQs.size}/${currentMCQs.size}"
            return
        }

        val mcq = currentMCQs[currentIndex]
        val theme = ThemeManager.getCurrentTheme(requireContext())
        tvQuestionNumber.text = "QUESTION ${currentIndex + 1}"
        tvQuestion.text = mcq.question
        layoutExplanation.visibility = View.GONE
        btnNext.visibility = View.GONE
        tvProgress.text = "${currentIndex + 1}/${currentMCQs.size}"

        layoutOptions.removeAllViews()

        for ((index, option) in mcq.options.withIndex()) {
            val letter = ('A' + index).toString()
            val optionView = TextView(requireContext()).apply {
                text = "$letter    $option"
                setTextColor(theme.textPrimary)
                textSize = 15f
                setPadding(24, 24, 24, 24)

                val bg = GradientDrawable().apply {
                    shape = GradientDrawable.RECTANGLE
                    cornerRadius = 14f
                    setColor(theme.surface)
                    setStroke(1, theme.border)
                }
                background = bg

                setOnClickListener {
                    if (!isAnswered) {
                        selectedAnswer = index
                        isAnswered = true
                        showResult(mcq)
                    }
                }
            }

            val params = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
            ).apply { setMargins(0, 0, 0, 12) }

            layoutOptions.addView(optionView, params)
        }

        // Animate options in
        for (i in 0 until layoutOptions.childCount) {
            val child = layoutOptions.getChildAt(i)
            child.alpha = 0f
            child.translationY = 20f
            child.animate()
                .alpha(1f)
                .translationY(0f)
                .setDuration(250)
                .setStartDelay(i * 60L)
                .setInterpolator(DecelerateInterpolator(1.5f))
                .start()
        }
    }

    private fun showResult(mcq: MCQ) {
        val theme = ThemeManager.getCurrentTheme(requireContext())
        val isCorrect = selectedAnswer == mcq.correctIndex

        if (isCorrect) correctCount++ else wrongCount++
        updateScoreDisplay()

        for (i in 0 until layoutOptions.childCount) {
            val optionView = layoutOptions.getChildAt(i) as TextView
            val isOptionCorrect = i == mcq.correctIndex
            val isSelected = i == selectedAnswer

            val bg = GradientDrawable().apply {
                shape = GradientDrawable.RECTANGLE
                cornerRadius = 14f
                when {
                    isOptionCorrect -> {
                        setColor(theme.success.copy(alpha = 30))
                        setStroke(2, theme.success)
                    }
                    isSelected && !isOptionCorrect -> {
                        setColor(theme.error.copy(alpha = 30))
                        setStroke(2, theme.error)
                    }
                    else -> {
                        setColor(theme.surface)
                        setStroke(1, theme.border)
                    }
                }
            }
            optionView.background = bg
        }

        if (mcq.explanation.isNotBlank()) {
            tvExplanation.text = mcq.explanation
            layoutExplanation.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        }

        btnNext.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        btnNext.text = if (currentIndex + 1 >= currentMCQs.size) "See Results" else "Next Question"
        mcqRepo.updateSM2(mcq.id, if (isCorrect) 4 else 1)
    }
}

Build successful. Both **APK** (9.7 MB) and **AAB** (11.5 MB) are in `dist/`. Here's what was redesigned:

---

### Theme System
- **"Midnight" (dark)**: GitHub-inspired palette — `#0D1117` bg, `#161B22` surfaces, `#58A6FF` accent, proper semantic colors
- **"Paper" (light)**: Warm off-white — `#F6F8FA` bg, white surfaces, `#0969DA` accent
- New design tokens: `surfaceHigh`, `accentSoft`, border colors, radius values, spacing scale in `dimens.xml`

### Decks Page
- Header with "Study materials at a glance" subtitle
- "Due" chip with accent-soft background
- Deck cards: accent color bar indicator (blue = has due cards, green = all done), arrow chevron, staggered slide-in animation
- Empty state with clear CTA

### Generate Page
- Step-by-step numbered flow (1. Name, 2. Content, 3. Quantity)
- Styled inputs with rounded borders matching the theme
- Scan + Import buttons with secondary styling
- Better progress/status feedback

### Flashcard Review
- Card displayed in a rounded flashcard container with padding
- "Tap to Reveal" button replaces generic "Show Answer"
- Rating buttons (Again/Good/Easy) stagger-animate in after flip
- Slide-out/slide-in card transitions

### Quiz (MCQ)
- Question number badge ("QUESTION 3")
- Options with letter labels (A, B, C, D) and rounded borders
- Correct/wrong highlighting with color-coded backgrounds
- Live score bar (✓ 5  ✗ 2)
- Explanation section with "Explanation" label
- Staggered option animation on each question

### Navigation & Polish
- Custom vector icons for all 4 tabs
- Thin divider line above bottom nav
- Fade transitions between fragments
- Page-level slide-in animations on load
- Edge-to-edge display with proper status bar handling
- Theme switch triggers `recreate()` for clean state

# No AI Slop

[](#no-ai-slop)

Remove 20+ patterns of AI slop from your writing without flattening your personal voice.

no-ai-slop-launch.mp4

## Problem

[](#problem)

AI makes it easy to generate clean writing that all sounds the same. Even the best models keep producing lines like:

-   “It’s not X. It’s Y.”
-   “What nobody tells you is…”
-   “The future isn’t coming. It’s already here.”

When you use AI to edit, it can also smooth away the vocabulary, cadence, humor, and imperfections that make the writing sound like you.

## How to install No AI Slop

[](#how-to-install-no-ai-slop)

The easiest way to install the skill is to paste this into ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex, or your favorite coding agent:

```
Install the /no-ai-slop skill globally from https://github.com/petergyang/no-ai-slop
```

You can also install it with `npx`:

npx skills add petergyang/no-ai-slop --skill no-ai-slop --global --yes

## How to use No AI Slop

[](#how-to-use-no-ai-slop)

### Edit your writing

[](#edit-your-writing)

```
/no-ai-slop (your writing)
```

The skill removes the AI slop patterns, preserves your personal voice, and lists what it changed.

### Detect slop

[](#detect-slop)

```
/no-ai-slop is this slop? (your writing)
```

The skill quotes every slop pattern it found without guessing whether AI wrote the text.

### Generate slop for fun

[](#generate-slop-for-fun)

```
Draft an AI slop post about (topic)
```

Use it to generate the most cringe AI slop possible as satire.

## The slop that this skill catches

[](#the-slop-that-this-skill-catches)

No AI Slop checks for 20+ patterns, including:

1.  **Binary contrasts.** “It’s not X. It’s Y.”
2.  **Throat-clearing openers.** “Here’s the thing,” “Let me be clear”
3.  **Faux-insight setups.** “What nobody tells you,” “The part everyone misses”
4.  **Colon reveals.** “The best part: it learns.”
5.  **Dramatic fragments.** “That’s it. That’s the whole thing.”
6.  **Superficial analysis.** “highlighting the team’s commitment to innovation”
7.  **Importance puffery.** “marks a pivotal moment,” “a testament to”
8.  **Weasel attribution.** “experts agree,” “studies show”
9.  **Synonym cycling.** “The agent handles your email. The assistant drafts replies.”
10.  **Fake-profound endings.** “The future isn’t coming. It’s already here.”

It also checks the fundamentals: Lead with the point when that helps, use active voice, untangle hard-to-follow sentences, and prefer concrete details over abstractions.

## What’s inside

[](#whats-inside)

-   [`SKILL.md`](/petergyang/no-ai-slop/blob/main/skills/no-ai-slop/SKILL.md) contains the editing rules and workflow.
-   [`eval.md`](/petergyang/no-ai-slop/blob/main/skills/no-ai-slop/eval.md) contains the checks the skill runs on its work.
-   [`.codex-plugin/plugin.json`](/petergyang/no-ai-slop/blob/main/.codex-plugin/plugin.json) contains the ChatGPT and Codex plugin metadata.
-   [`build_plugin.py`](/petergyang/no-ai-slop/blob/main/scripts/build_plugin.py) builds and validates the plugin package.

No AI Slop is also available as a plugin in ChatGPT.

## Installing

[](#installing)

The [`npx skills add`](https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-skills) CLI scans the `skills/` folder in this repo, so **all skills below (code and image-generation) install the same way.**

npx skills add https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill

Install a single skill by its **install name** (the `name:` field inside the SKILL frontmatter, not the folder name):

npx skills add https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill --skill "design-taste-frontend"

You can also copy any `SKILL.md` into your project or paste it into ChatGPT / Codex conversations.

### Updating from the previous version

[](#updating-from-the-previous-version)

The default `taste-skill` (install name `design-taste-frontend`) is now **v2 (experimental)**, a substantial rewrite of the original v1. If you already have v1 installed, just re-run the install command and you will be upgraded:

npx skills add https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill --skill "design-taste-frontend"

The install name did not change, so no script updates are needed. The newer SKILL.md replaces the older one in place.

If you depend on the exact behavior of v1 and want to pin to it explicitly:

npx skills add https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill --skill "design-taste-frontend-v1"

See [CHANGELOG.md](/Leonxlnx/taste-skill/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for the full v1 to v2 diff and the rationale.

Each skill does one job; you do not need all of them at once. **Implementation skills** output code. **Image-generation skills** output reference images only.

### Which one should I use?

[](#which-one-should-i-use)

-   Start with **taste-skill** for the safest general default. (Now v2 experimental - see what changed in the [CHANGELOG](/Leonxlnx/taste-skill/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).)
-   If you depend on the exact behavior of the original taste-skill, install **taste-skill-v1** instead.
-   Use **gpt-taste** when you want the stricter GPT/Codex-oriented rules and motion/layout enforcement.
-   Use **image-to-code-skill** for image → analyze → code website workflows.
-   Use **redesign-skill** to improve an existing codebase instead of greenfield styling.
-   Add **soft-skill**, **minimalist-skill**, or **brutalist-skill** when the visual direction is already chosen.
-   Add **output-skill** if the agent keeps truncating output.
-   Use **imagegen-frontend-web**, **imagegen-frontend-mobile**, or **brandkit** when the deliverable is **images** (comps, flows, identity boards), then pass results to your coding agent.

### Image-first tip

[](#image-first-tip)

For **image-to-code-skill**, state the pipeline in the prompt, e.g.: `follow the skill: generate images, then analyze, then code`.

### ChatGPT Images and Codex

[](#chatgpt-images-and-codex)

Attach or paste **`imagegen-frontend-web`**, **`imagegen-frontend-mobile`**, or **`brandkit`** and ask for the frames you need, then feed the renders to Codex, Cursor, or Claude Code. Use **image-to-code-skill** when you want one workflow that both generates references and implements the site in code.

## Settings (taste-skill only)

[](#settings-taste-skill-only)

Numbers at the top of the file are 1-10 dials:

-   **DESIGN\_VARIANCE**: Layout experimentation (lower: centered/clean · higher: asymmetric/modern).
-   **MOTION\_INTENSITY**: Animation depth (lower: hover · higher: scroll/magnetic).
-   **VISUAL\_DENSITY**: Information per viewport (lower: spacious · higher: dense dashboards).

## Common Questions

[](#common-questions)

**How is this different from other AI design skills?**  
Multiple specialized variants, adjustable dials in key skills, anti-repetition rules informed by dedicated research. All are framework agnostic across major coding agents.

**Does it work with React, Vue, Svelte?**  
Yes. Rules target design intent, not a single framework API.

**What is SKILL.md?**  
A portable instruction file agents can load automatically; install via `npx skills add` or by copying into a repo or conversation.

**Do image-generation skills install with `npx skills add`?**  
Yes. They live under `skills/` alongside the code skills so the same CLI discovers them.
